The 2023 PEI Global Technology Private Equity Firm of the Year recognition is an annual recognition that was presented 03/2024. The 2020-2025 Inc. Founder-Friendly Investors list is an annual recognition that was presented in October of each year, which included a participation fee for consideration as well as fees for related matters such a logo rights and advertisements associated with these awards. Mergers & Acquisitions' Middle-Market Deals of the Year recognition is an annual recognition that was presented 05/2025 which included a fee for logo rights associated with this award. The 2023 PEWIN General Partner of the Year North America recognition is an annual recognition that was presented 07/2023. The 2022 GrowthCap Top 25 Private Equity Firms recognition is an annual recognition that was presented 09/2022, which included a participation fee for consideration as well as fees for related matters such a logo rights associated with this award. The 2023 GrowthCap Top Private Equity Firms recognition is an annual recognition that was presented 09/2023, which included a participation fee for consideration as well as fees for related matters such a logo rights associated with this award. The 2024 GrowthCap Top Private Equity Firms recognition is an annual recognition that was presented 08/2024, which included a participation fee for consideration as well as fees for related matters such a logo rights associated with this award.

Our Values

A Foundation _for Success_

Our mission is to deliver compelling, consistent results and unlock potential for our investors, people and companies.​


01


Honor the Opportunity

We believe in doing what is right, not what is easy. We earn the trust and confidence of our partners and each other by acting with respect, integrity and accountability.

02


Operate With Excellence

We commit to being exceptional and own the result. We strive to be the best version of ourselves while holding each other to the highest standards. ​

03


Embrace Collaboration

We believe that inclusivity and diverse perspectives enable our shared success. We reward teamwork and celebrate those who collaborate to deliver exceptional results. ​

04


Relentlessly Improve

We have a constant drive to evolve. We champion a culture of learning and growth to ensure we are always advancing, innovating and the best ideas win. ​
